verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own API covers the core UI functions. Inference runs through OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic and Open Responses endpoints, and models can be installed via the documented /models/apply endpoint, which parallels the UI gallery. However, nothing shows the API matches everything else the built-in web UI does, such as agent configuration or chat message editing, and no published OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity claim, documented API for agent creation/configuration and user/admin management, published OpenAPI/endpoint reference, independent corroboration.
